title: Dashboard displays real-time system metrics
description: Verify that the Dashboard component shows accurate real-time CPU, RAM, and disk usage metrics and updates dynamically.

steps.description: Launch the OptiAI desktop app and navigate to the Dashboard.
Check that CPU, RAM, and disk usage metrics are displayed.
Verify metrics update dynamically every few seconds.

title: Filesystem scan detects duplicate files and large files
description: Ensure the Filesystem Scanner performs multithreaded analysis detecting duplicate files and identifying large files correctly.

steps.description: Initiate a filesystem scan from the ScanPanel component.
Verify scan completes without errors and returns a detailed file list.
Check duplicate files are correctly identified.
Verify large file alerts appear for files exceeding threshold size.

title: AI Assistant generates valid and safe optimization suggestions
description: Validate that the AI Assistant uses local LLM to produce contextual, policy-validated optimization plans with prioritized actions and risk badges.

steps.description: Perform a filesystem scan and pass results to the AI Assistant.
Check AI-generated optimization suggestions are returned.
Verify all suggestions comply with security policy rules and JSON schema validation.
Confirm risk badges are correctly assigned to suggest potential hazards.

title: Encrypted Vault stores and retrieves data securely
description: Ensure the Vault feature encrypts sensitive data using AES-256-GCM with Argon2id key derivation and enforces password protection for access.

steps.description: Access the Vault tab and create a new password-protected vault.
Store sample sensitive data into the vault.
Close and re-open the vault, providing the correct password.
Verify stored data is decrypted accurately.
Attempt vault access with incorrect password.
Confirm access is denied and data remains encrypted.

title: Process management module monitors and terminates processes
description: Verify real-time monitoring of system processes and the ability to safely terminate selected processes.

steps.description: Navigate to the Processes page.
Check the list of currently running processes is displayed accurately.
Select a non-critical process and initiate termination.
Confirm the process is terminated successfully and no system instability occurs.

title: Startup management modifies Windows startup programs correctly
description: Validate ability to add, remove, and disable Windows startup programs safely through the startup management module.

steps.description: Navigate to the Startup page while running on Windows.
Verify current startup programs are listed.
Disable an existing startup program.
Confirm the change is saved and reflected on Windows startup.
Re-enable the disabled startup program.
Verify the program runs at next system startup.

title: Safe Action Engine executes and undoes system optimization actions
description: Confirm that optimization actions are validated, executed safely with backups, quarantined if needed, and undo functionality restores prior state correctly.

steps.description: From AI suggestions, approve an optimization action for execution.
Verify action is validated against policy.yaml whitelist before execution.
Check action is executed successfully with backup and quarantine if applicable.
Navigate to ActionHistory panel and undo the executed action.
Confirm system state is fully restored to pre-action conditions.

title: Quarantine feature retains deleted files for 7 days before removal
description: Verify that deleted files during actions are quarantined and retained exactly seven days prior to permanent deletion.

steps.description: Execute a file deletion action using the Safe Action Engine.
Confirm the deleted file is moved to the quarantine area immediately.
Simulate the passage of 7 days.
Verify the quarantined file is permanently removed after 7 days.

title: Tool Discovery tab recommends and installs GitHub tools
description: Ensure AI-powered recommendations provide relevant GitHub repositories and that one-click installations complete successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the Discover tab.
Verify AI-generated tool recommendations appear.
Select a recommended tool and initiate installation.
Confirm the installation completes without errors and the tool appears in InstalledApps.

title: Security policy enforcement prevents unsafe file operations
description: Validate all file operations are verified against policy.yaml whitelist including protected paths, batch sizes, and high-risk confirmation prompts.

steps.description: Attempt to execute a file operation on a protected system path.
Verify the action is blocked and user is notified about policy restriction.
Attempt a large batch file operation exceeding policy limits.
Check the action is either blocked or requires explicit user confirmation.

title: LLM suggestions are sanitized and policy validated
description: Confirm that AI suggestions are sanitized against injection or unsafe operations and validated before applying any changes.

steps.description: Request AI Assistant to generate optimization plan for complex scan results.
Inspect AI output for embedded malicious commands or unsafe operations.
Verify output passes internal validation and is approved for execution only if safe.

title: UI components function correctly with responsive layout and animation
description: Test all major UI components for proper rendering, responsiveness on different screen sizes, smooth animations, and error boundary handling.

steps.description: Navigate through Dashboard, ScanPanel, AI Assistant, Vault, and other UI tabs.
Verify UI adjusts properly on various screen resolutions.
Check animations using Framer Motion run smoothly.
Introduce simulated UI errors or network failures.
Confirm error boundaries display fallback UI without crashing.

title: API communication handles errors and implements caching
description: Validate that REST API calls use caching to improve performance and handle errors gracefully without breaking functionality.

steps.description: Perform multiple API calls for scan data and AI suggestions.
Verify responses are cached and reused for repeated identical requests.
Simulate network failure during API calls.
Confirm the app displays meaningful error messages and recovers gracefully.

title: Desktop app builds and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux
description: Check that the Tauri desktop application builds successfully for all supported platforms and runs with native API access and proper functionality.

steps.description: Trigger production build for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Ensure build completes without errors and produces platform-specific installers.
Install and launch the application on each platform.
Verify native system integrations work, including file access and process management.

title: System actions execute using only safe Python standard library methods
description: Verify that all filesystem and system operations are executed exclusively with Python standard libraries without invoking shell commands or unsafe system calls.

steps.description: Inspect logs and code execution during various system actions.
Confirm no shell commands or subprocess calls are executed.
Verify all actions utilize Python standard library APIs appropriately.
